profile_text.body:
Duolingo describes itself on its site as a way to learn languages by playing a game, calling it 100 percent free, fun, and scientifically proven to work. The company says it is the world's most popular way to learn a language and that users can practice online at duolingo.com or on its apps.

Its tracked education product is Duolingo for Schools, listed under Education and Research AI, which the company offers free. The product is described as using AI for adaptive assignments and as serving students and teachers. According to the held record, student age rules allow under-13 users with restrictions: no public profile, leaderboards, forums, or social logins, and non-personalized ads for users under 16. The same record states there is no signed California Student Data Privacy Agreement per a K-12 data leadership directory.
